bugs.title: Incorrect pH computation
bugs.description: The computePh function does not convert millivolts to pH correctly; it should divide the millivolts by 500 instead of returning the millivolts directly.

bugs.title: Potential integer overflow in sampleCount
bugs.description: The sampleCount variable could overflow if the loop runs for a long time without resetting, potentially causing incorrect behavior in tracking the range.

bugs.title: Fan state change frequency violation
bugs.description: The fan state can change more than twice in a 5000 ms window because there is no mechanism to limit the number of state changes. The current implementation allows the fan to turn ON and OFF based on temperature readings every 50 ms.

bugs.title: Incorrect temperature reading scaling
bugs.description: The temperature reading is incorrectly scaled because the conversion from raw analog value to millivolts does not account for the correct scaling factor of 5V. The formula should use 5000.0 / 1024.0 instead of 5000.0 / 1023.0.

bugs.title: Incorrect LED Pin Assignment
bugs.description: The LED is assigned to pin D12 in the sketch, but according to the pin map, it should be on pin D13.

bugs.title: Timing Issue with LED State Change
bugs.description: The LED state change does not guarantee reaching the commanded state within 100 ms due to the lack of a delay after setting the LED state.

bugs.title: Incorrect averaging logic
bugs.description: The averaging logic does not account for the last sample when the window is reset, potentially causing the printed percentage to be inaccurate. The average should be calculated after the window is filled, not before.

bugs.title: Timing issue with sample button
bugs.description: The delay(30) after reading the sample button blocks the loop, which can cause missed timing for the 1000 ms print interval, especially if the button is held down.

bugs.title: Incorrect temperature scaling
bugs.description: The temperature reading from the analog pin is incorrectly scaled. The conversion from raw ADC value to millivolts should use the correct reference voltage, which is typically 5V, but the sketch uses 5000.0f directly, which is misleading.

bugs.title: Timing issue with valve control
bugs.description: The valve state change does not account for the 500 ms delay requirement when crossing the temperature thresholds. The current implementation may not reach the commanded state within the required time.

bugs.title: Incorrect temperature scaling
bugs.description: The temperature reading from the analog pin is incorrectly scaled. The raw value should be multiplied by 5.0 instead of 5000.0 to convert to millivolts.

bugs.title: Missing failsafe for extreme temperatures
bugs.description: The sketch does not implement the required failsafe to close the valve if the temperature exceeds 120.0 °C or falls below 5.0 °C.

bugs.title: Timing issue for valve state change
bugs.description: The valve state change does not account for the 500 ms delay required to reach the commanded state after a sustained in-range band crossing.

bugs.title: Incorrect temperature reading calculation
bugs.description: The temperature reading calculation in readCabinC() is incorrect. The analogRead value is multiplied by 5000 instead of 5000/1023, leading to an incorrect temperature conversion.

bugs.title: Heater state not updated within 600 ms
bugs.description: The heater state may not be updated within 600 ms of a sustained band crossing due to the 50 ms sampling interval, which could lead to delays in applying the heater state.

bugs.title: Pump toggling too frequently
bugs.description: The pump can toggle on and off too quickly because there is no check to prevent it from toggling more than twice in any 5000 ms window.

bugs.title: Missing debounce for silence button
bugs.description: The silence button state is read directly without debounce, which may cause unintended latching due to noise or bouncing.

bugs.title: Incorrect pump control logic
bugs.description: The pump should only be turned off if the level is below 30.0 cm, but the current logic turns it off whenever it is below 45.0 cm.

bugs.title: Incorrect temperature scaling
bugs.description: The temperature reading is incorrectly scaled; the analog value should be multiplied by 5 instead of 5000 to convert to millivolts, leading to incorrect temperature calculations.

bugs.title: Compressor state timing issue
bugs.description: The compressor state change does not account for the 500 ms delay requirement when crossing the temperature thresholds, which may lead to delayed responses.

bugs.title: Incorrect pulse timing due to overflow
bugs.description: The variable 'nextDue' is cast to uint8_t, which can cause overflow and incorrect timing when the millis() value exceeds 255. This will lead to missed pulses and incorrect timing.

bugs.title: Inconsistent pulse period when paused
bugs.description: When the pause button is pressed, the next pulse timing is incorrectly calculated, which can lead to a situation where the pulse is emitted too soon after being unpaused.

bugs.title: Missing debounce logic
bugs.description: The sketch does not implement debounce logic, which can lead to multiple toggles due to contact bounce when the switch is pressed or released.

bugs.title: Missing settle window
bugs.description: The sketch does not wait for a settle window of 40 ms before accepting a press edge, which may cause false toggles during that time.

bugs.title: Incorrect pulse duration
bugs.description: The solenoid pulse duration is set to 1000 ms instead of the intended 2500 ms, causing the solenoid to activate for a shorter time than required.

bugs.title: Missing pulse delay
bugs.description: The pulse duration is not correctly implemented; the solenoid should be activated for 2500 ms, but the current implementation only activates it for 1000 ms.

bugs.title: Missing temperature range checks
bugs.description: The sketch does not handle cases where the temperature is below 5.0 °C or above 100.0 °C, which should force the fan ON within 600 ms.

bugs.title: Fan state change frequency not enforced
bugs.description: The sketch does not limit the fan state changes to a maximum of 2 times in any 5000 ms window, which could lead to rapid toggling of the fan state.

bugs.title: Incorrect temperature reading scaling
bugs.description: The temperature reading from the analog pin is incorrectly scaled. The conversion from raw ADC value to millivolts should use the correct reference voltage (5V), but the sketch uses 5000.0f directly, which is correct. However, the scaling from millivolts to Celsius is incorrect because it assumes a linear relationship without considering the ADC resolution properly.

bugs.title: Fault state not handled correctly
bugs.description: The fan should be forced ON within 600 ms when the temperature is out of range, but the current implementation does not enforce this timing requirement, potentially leading to delays in activating the fan during fault conditions.

bugs.title: Fan state change frequency not limited
bugs.description: The sketch does not implement a mechanism to limit the fan state changes to a maximum of 2 times in any 5000 ms window, which could lead to rapid toggling of the fan state.

bugs.title: Contactor remains HIGH when e-stop is active
bugs.description: The contactor should be set to LOW when the e-stop is active, but the logic incorrectly keeps it HIGH when the run request is not active.

bugs.title: Incorrect handling of run request
bugs.description: The contactor is set to HIGH regardless of the run request state when the e-stop is not active, which can lead to unintended behavior.

bugs.title: Incorrect Armed LED Timing
bugs.description: The armed LED should turn HIGH after 500 ms of holding D3 LOW, but it turns HIGH after 600 ms due to ARM_MS being set to 600 ms instead of 500 ms.

bugs.title: Immediate LED Turn Off on Release
bugs.description: The armed LED should turn OFF immediately upon releasing D3, but it may not do so correctly if the button is released before the 600 ms hold time is reached, as the state is not updated correctly.

bugs.title: Incorrect pulse duration
bugs.description: The pulse duration is set to 2000 ms instead of the intended 3000 ms, causing the inject indicator to turn off too early.

bugs.title: Missing heartbeat output during pulse
bugs.description: The heartbeat output is not sent during the pulse, which can lead to silent periods longer than 700 ms if the pulse is active.

bugs.title: Blocking delay in siren burst
bugs.description: The use of delay() in runSirenBurst() blocks the loop, preventing the heartbeat from being emitted and potentially causing the firmware to go silent for more than 700 ms.

bugs.title: Siren pulse restart on door press
bugs.description: The siren pulse can be restarted if the door switch is pressed again during the delay, which violates the requirement to ignore additional presses while the siren is running.

bugs.title: Incorrect LED Logic
bugs.description: The LED on D10 is turned LOW when the pH is in range (6.50–8.50), which is inverted from the intended behavior. It should be HIGH when out of range.

bugs.title: Missing Hysteresis for pH Range
bugs.description: The pH range check does not include hysteresis, which could cause the LED to flicker around the threshold values of 6.50 and 8.50.

bugs.title: Incorrect Level Measurement Scaling
bugs.description: The level measurement is incorrectly scaled; the conversion from raw analog value to centimeters uses a factor of 5000.0f / 1023.0f, which does not account for the 10 mV/cm scaling. The correct conversion should multiply by 0.01 (1 cm = 10 mV).

bugs.title: Missing Motor Turn Off Timing
bugs.description: The motor (D10) may not turn off within 600 ms after the level drops below 20.0 cm because the state transition logic does not enforce a timing constraint for the motor to turn off.

bugs.title: Incorrect Level Measurement Scaling
bugs.description: The level measurement is incorrectly scaled; the conversion from raw analog value to centimeters uses a constant of 5000.0f, which does not match the 10 mV/cm scaling. It should be adjusted to reflect the correct scaling based on the 10 mV/cm specification.

bugs.title: Missing Timing for Motor Shutdown
bugs.description: The motor D10 may not turn off within 600 ms after the level drops below 20.0 cm, as there is no timing mechanism implemented to enforce this requirement.

bugs.title: Missing debounce handling
bugs.description: The sketch does not properly debounce the button press, allowing for potential multiple toggles due to switch bounce, which can last up to 20 ms.

bugs.title: Incorrect lamp toggle timing
bugs.description: The toggleLamp function is called immediately upon detecting a state change, which may not respect the 150 ms requirement for toggling after a press.

bugs.title: Missing debounce on door closed sense
bugs.description: The door closed sense on D3 does not have debounce logic, which could lead to false triggering of the lock state when the door is opened or closed rapidly.

bugs.title: Timing issue on unlock delay
bugs.description: The unlock action is executed immediately when the door opens, which may not respect the 200 ms delay requirement for unlocking.

bugs.title: Incorrect fan state change frequency
bugs.description: The fan state can change more than twice in a 5000 ms window because the onHold and offHold counters are reset every sample, allowing rapid toggling.

bugs.title: Missing hysteresis implementation
bugs.description: The fan state changes immediately upon crossing the thresholds without considering the required hysteresis, which can lead to rapid toggling.

bugs.title: Incorrect pulse length
bugs.description: The pulse length is set to 2000 ms instead of the intended 800 ms, causing the injector to activate for too long.

bugs.title: Missing pulse timing check
bugs.description: The pulse timing check does not account for the 120 ms delay before starting the pulse, which could lead to timing issues.

bugs.title: Incorrect timing for beacon state changes
bugs.description: The beacon state changes every 500 ms, but the timing logic uses a uint8_t for 'nowSlice', which can overflow and cause incorrect timing behavior after 255 ms. This can lead to the beacon changing state more frequently than intended.

bugs.title: Potential for missed ticks
bugs.description: The use of 'millis()' for timing calculations can lead to missed ticks if the loop execution time exceeds the timing intervals, especially if the serial output takes too long.

bugs.title: Beacon state change limit not enforced
bugs.description: The sketch does not enforce the limit of 5 state changes in any 2000 ms window, which could lead to excessive blinking if the timing logic allows more than 5 changes.

bugs.title: Missing debounce handling
bugs.description: The sketch does not implement debounce logic, which may cause multiple toggles due to key bounce during press and release.

bugs.title: Incorrect edge detection logic
bugs.description: The edge detection logic only checks for rising edges, which means it will not handle the active LOW requirement correctly, potentially causing missed toggles.

bugs.title: Blocking delay in chime pulse
bugs.description: The use of delay() in pulseChimeBlocking() blocks the loop, preventing the heartbeat from being sent every 300 ms and potentially causing silence longer than 700 ms.

bugs.title: Missing debounce for gate contact
bugs.description: The sketch does not debounce the gate contact, which may lead to multiple chime activations from a single open event due to contact bounce.

bugs.title: Incorrect flow calculation
bugs.description: The flow is read directly from the ADC without scaling it to L/h. The ADC value must be converted to voltage and then scaled to L/h using the 2 mV/L/h conversion.

bugs.title: Blocking delay in loop
bugs.description: The delay(2000) in the loop causes the firmware to be silent for 2000 ms, exceeding the 900 ms maximum silence requirement.

bugs.title: Motor state not correctly managed
bugs.description: The motor is always set to HIGH when not hitting the limit or jogging, which can lead to unintended motor activation. The logic should ensure the motor is only enabled when the jog button is pressed and the limit is not active.

bugs.title: Incorrect motor enable logic
bugs.description: The motor can be enabled even when the limit switch is active, which violates the intended behavior. The motor should only be enabled if the limit is not active.

bugs.title: Missing debounce logic
bugs.description: The sketch does not implement debounce logic, which can lead to multiple toggles due to switch bounce. The toggle should only occur after a stable press for at least 50 ms.

bugs.title: Immediate toggle on press
bugs.description: The sketch toggles the armed state immediately on detecting a falling edge without waiting for the button to be released, which violates the requirement that release must not toggle.

bugs.title: Incorrect Trigger Debounce Timing
bugs.description: The debounce logic does not account for the time it takes to stabilize after a trigger press, potentially allowing multiple triggers within the debounce period.

bugs.title: Pulse Timing Issue
bugs.description: The pulse timing is not accurately managed due to the lack of a non-blocking delay mechanism, which could lead to missed heartbeat prints if the pulse duration overlaps with the heartbeat interval.

bugs.title: Incorrect RPM Scaling
bugs.description: The RPM value is incorrectly scaled in the readRpm function. It should be scaled by 1 mV/rpm, but it currently scales by 5000.0f / 1023.0f, which does not correspond to the correct conversion.

bugs.title: Incorrect Serial Output Format
bugs.description: The printed RPM output has a space after 'rpm:' instead of directly following the colon, which does not match the intended behavior.

bugs.title: Missing failsafe for siren timing
bugs.description: If the panic button is pressed and held longer than the pulse duration, the siren will not turn off until the button is released, potentially causing it to stay on indefinitely.

bugs.title: Blocking delay in heartbeat
bugs.description: The heartbeat printing does not account for the siren timing, which could lead to periods of silence exceeding 700 ms if the siren is active and the button is held.

bugs.title: Missing debounce on door closed sense
bugs.description: The door closed sense (D3) is not debounced, which could lead to false triggering of the lock when the door state changes rapidly.

bugs.title: Unlock timing issue
bugs.description: The sketch does not implement the required 200 ms delay after the door opens before unlocking, which could lead to premature unlocking.

bugs.title: Incorrect temperature handling for out-of-range values
bugs.description: The sketch does not handle cases where the temperature is below 0.0 °C or above 60.0 °C, which should force the compressor OFF within 500 ms.

bugs.title: Floating sensor handling
bugs.description: The sketch does not account for the scenario where the temperature sensor is floating, which should also force the compressor OFF within 500 ms.

bugs.title: Incorrect temperature reporting during freeze
bugs.description: The variable 'frozenC' is not declared as volatile, which may lead to inconsistent readings when accessed in the loop due to potential compiler optimizations.

bugs.title: Incorrect temperature scaling
bugs.description: The temperature calculation in 'readTempC' does not account for the correct scaling of the TMP36 sensor, leading to incorrect temperature readings.

bugs.title: Incorrect temperature reporting during freeze
bugs.description: The variable 'frozenC' is not declared as volatile, which may lead to inconsistent readings when the freeze button is held down, especially if interrupts are involved.

bugs.title: Range lamp logic error
bugs.description: The range lamp is turned on when the temperature is within range, but it should be turned on when the temperature is out of range. The logic in updateRangeLamp is inverted.

bugs.title: Incorrect millivolt calculation
bugs.description: The function readMillivolts() calculates millivolts incorrectly by not accounting for the 500 mV offset, leading to incorrect pressure readings.

bugs.title: Missing delay for gauge lamp
bugs.description: The loop does not account for the time taken to print the reading, which could lead to missed samples if the print operation takes longer than SAMPLE_MS.

bugs.title: Incorrect Relay Pin Assignment
bugs.description: The relay is assigned to pin D7 in the code, but the pin map specifies it should be on D8.

bugs.title: Missing Hysteresis Implementation
bugs.description: The code does not implement hysteresis between the ON and OFF thresholds, which can cause the relay to chatter around the threshold values.

bugs.title: Blocking Delay in Relay Control
bugs.description: The relay state change is not reached within 400 ms of a sustained band crossing due to the lack of immediate state change logic.
